hero.photo_alt: The gated courtyard of Top 2 Hotels and Suites, with solar panels across the roof.
hero.title: Stay in Rumuolumeni
hero.text: Rooms, an events hall and a restaurant behind one gate — with solar backup, so the lights and the air conditioning stay on.

hero.photo_alt: The Top 2 events hall, laid out with tables and chairs facing the stage.
hero.title: Room for two hundred
hero.text: A pillared hall with its own entrance, a stage end and catering from the kitchen on site.

hero.photo_alt: The Top 2 reception lounge, with red and green velvet seating.
hero.title: Come in and sit down
hero.text: A lounge off reception, a restaurant, and the shawarma hut at the gate — open late.

c1.photo_alt: The Top 2 Hotels and Suites roadside sign on Charles Ogun Street.
c1.title: Easy to find
c1.text: 1 Charles Ogun Street, Mgboudohia, Rumuolumeni — west Port Harcourt, off the Rumuolumeni road.

c2.photo_alt: A guest corridor with polished floors and cove lighting.
c2.title: Power that holds
c2.text: Rooftop solar feeding a battery bank, with a generator behind it. Rooms and the hall stay lit and cool through the usual outages.

c3.photo_alt: The marble reception desk at Top 2, with a member of staff answering the phone beneath a gold feature wall.
c3.title: Someone is always at the desk
c3.text: Reception is staffed around the clock, behind a manned gate with CCTV through the corridors and free parking inside the wall.

classic.photo_alt: A Classic Room with a blue upholstered headboard, double bed, armchair and bedside table.
classic.name: Classic Room
classic.text: A double room with an armchair and a work surface — the everyday room for one or two guests.

executive.photo_alt: The Executive Room: a king bed with a black padded headboard in a marble surround with reading lights, a patterned armchair, side table and framed mirror.
executive.name: Executive Room
executive.text: A king bed and more floor space, with a seating corner — the room to take for a longer stay.

deluxe.photo_alt: The Deluxe Room: a king bed against a patterned headboard with wall lights, a dressing table and mirror, and a moulded gold ceiling.
deluxe.name: Deluxe Room
deluxe.text: The largest room on the property — a king bed, a dressing table and enough floor to move around in. Take this one for a family or a week.

events.hall_photo_alt: The events hall set with tables and red, green and white chairs, facing the stage.
events.meeting_photo_alt: The meeting room, with skirted blue tables, folding chairs, a wall screen and marble panelling.

dining.bar_photo_alt: The Top 2 bar: a barred serving window onto a lit drinks fridge, with the hotel’s printed drinks list on the wall beside it.
